body.x: Mondrian AI (CEO Hong Dae-ui) participated in CES 2024 held in Las Vegas, USA, from January 9th (Tuesday) to 12th (Friday, local time).

Mondrian AI, with researchers who are Ph.D. graduates from KAIST at its core, provides data analysis and artificial intelligence services. The company has led in building AI infrastructure, developing predictive models, and creating specialized AI solutions. It has received honors such as the Prime Minister’s Award and Incheon Mayor’s Award and has been selected as one of the top 100 AI companies for four consecutive years. The company also contributes to creating new value in future businesses by offering technological excellence and innovation to its customers.

One of its flagship products is the data processing platform for AI analysis, ‘Yennefer.’ In this regard, a Mondrian AI representative explained, “There were inconveniences in the AI research process, such as repetitive confirmation of output and installation environment, as well as difficulties in collaboration due to capacity shortage and version differences caused by local storage. To address these issues, we developed Yennefer, which allows everyone to perform tasks conveniently.”

The platform integrates the essential infrastructure, tools, and services for introducing data-centric AI into enterprises or organizations. Yennefer enables organizations to quickly establish an AI research and development environment, providing various features and requirements necessary for data analysts. It is a platform that allows comprehensive management of data analysis and AI service operations throughout the organization.

One of the advantages of Yennefer is its provision of an On-Premise model, allowing enterprises to use it freely without cost concerns, regardless of usage volume, after the initial setup. It is also integrated with appliances to deploy AI applications to private and hybrid clouds rapidly. This is a turnkey solution with computing and storage resources for quick deployment and scalability, suitable for new data centers, AI centers, and AI graduate schools.

The representative stated, “Yennefer has successfully undertaken platform construction projects with large enterprises, providing private cloud construction and appliances for AI. Moreover, we collaborated with Inha University’s AI Convergence Center to create Data Bridge and AI Bridge platforms. We have successfully executed various projects with organizations such as the Korea Expressway Corporation, Incheon Port Authority, and KT.”

Yennefer provides an efficient way to perform end-to-end processes, from data analysis by data scientists to ML development and model API deployment. Yennefer is sold through appliance sales and Private Cloud (cluster license) formats. However, Mondrian AI plans to support a usage-based billing system through Cloud Service, enhancing the value of businesses in various industries.

In addition, the representative mentioned, “In the future, we plan to establish a usage-based billing system through service-type software (SaaS) products and provide an AI model market service, allowing anyone to create and sell algorithms easily. We aim to offer an optimized solution that utilizes artificial intelligence throughout the entire business process, from data analysis to developing and operating customized AI models through ‘Fully Managed AI’ services. Furthermore, we will expand our marketing and business strategies to increase influence in the global market.”

body.x: The Consumer Technology Association (CTA) hosts CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition held annually in Las Vegas, USA, allowing visitors to grasp global trends in the home appliance industry at a glance. AVING News, covering CES for 18 consecutive years, has been reporting CES news worldwide since 2006 and selecting the best innovative products, companies, and technologies through ‘BEST OF CES’ and ‘BEST OF MADE IN KOREA.’ Additionally, through ‘AVING LIVE,’ they deliver real-time CES issues.

Incheon City exhibits at the LVCC North Hall AI·Robotics Zone with the “Incheon/IFEZ Pavilion” and the startup zone, “Eureka Park.” The pavilions include the Incheon Creative Economy Innovation Center and the Incheon Startup Park Joint Pavilion. As part of the pre-event promotion for participating companies from Incheon, the city organized a “Pre-global Media Interview” with Ubergizmo, a global media outlet that covers CES annually.
